review_requirements: Resolve the SAP's single primary 20mSRT endpoint on physical page 4 against physical pages 6-9, which expand primary analyses to accelerometry and multiple fitness variables.
Choose one executable 20mSRT outcome metric and primary test rather than treating completed stages and optional estimated VO2max as interchangeable.
Specify the primary multiplicity policy; FDR is currently optional and sensitivity-only despite multiple variables being called primary.
Finalize mediation, missing-data, intercurrent-event and adverse-event denominator rules rather than leaving alternative methods open.
Verify all critical locators against rendered one-based physical PDF pages during independent review.
